ambiguities: The claim that the parents' decision to stop sending the narrator to the Champs-Élysées was a pretext to separate him from Gilberte is presented only as the narrator's own suspicion ('je pensais bien'), not as a narrated fact, so this exclusion event is scored with reduced confidence.

status_effects.explanation: Her tireless, self-sacrificing care for the sick child, undertaken at visible personal cost, casts her in a positive light.
Being kept from the Champs-Élysées removes the narrator from Gilberte's company, a real if suspected exclusion from valued social space.
Her expressions of concern are reframed by the narrator as class/professional habit rather than personal sincerity, mildly deflating their weight.

appraisal_events.evidence: Elle me quitta aussitôt, j'entendis la porte cochère, et elle rentra un peu plus tard avec du cognac qu'elle était allée acheter parce qu'il n'y en avait pas à la maison. [...] avait l'air gêné, et ses yeux une expression de lassitude et de découragement.
appraisal_events.explanation: The grandmother's late-night effort to fetch cognac for the suffering child, despite her visible fatigue and discouragement, is narrated as an instance of quiet self-sacrificing devotion, elevating her local esteem.

appraisal_events.evidence: on parlait de ne plus m'envoyer aux Champs-Élysées [...] je pensais bien qu'on profitait du prétexte pour que je ne pusse plus voir Gilberte et je me contraignais à redire tout le temps le nom de Gilberte, comme ce langage natal que les vaincus s'efforcent de maintenir pour ne pas oublier la patrie qu'ils ne reverront pas.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator, as in-scene participant, is kept from the Champs-Élysées and thereby from Gilberte's company, a staged exclusion from valued social space, though the motive behind it is only his own suspicion.

appraisal_events.evidence: Ces déplorations tenaient plus à sa « classe » qu'à mon état de santé. [...] Je conclus provisoirement qu'il était social et professionnel.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator reinterprets Françoise's daily displays of alarm as a class-conditioned performance rather than genuine personal feeling, mildly deflating the sincerity of her concern.
